step1_figure.circuit_type: Delta-Sigma Modulator (DSM) Sensing Circuit for CMOS Image Sensors
step1_figure.description: The circuit is an all-MOS delta-sigma modulator sensing amplifier for CMOS image sensors. It subtracts charge proportional to the shifted intensity signal and the shifted reference signal onto bucket capacitors using switched-capacitor circuits, compares their potentials with a dynamic clocked comparator, and feeds back the latched decision (Q) to balance the charge.

shifted_reference_voltage.description: Effective gate overdrive / shifted reference voltage determining the charge packet size in the reference branch

equation.explanation: The reference voltage is applied to an NMOS source follower / switch branch, shifting the effective signal by the threshold voltage V_THN.
equation.assumptions: V_R = 0.65 V, NMOS operates with source-follower voltage drop approximately equal to V_THN.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Standard NMOS threshold in SKY130 is ~0.42 V with typical process variations giving ±50 mV.

shifted_intensity_voltage.description: Effective gate overdrive / shifted intensity voltage determining the charge packet size in the signal branch

equation.explanation: The light intensity signal voltage is shifted by the NMOS threshold voltage drop.
equation.assumptions: V_I = 0.50 V nominal (as specified in the netlist), V_THN ≈ 0.42 V.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends directly on the input signal intensity level and SKY130 NMOS threshold voltage.

resolution.description: Quantization voltage resolution of the delta-sigma sensing circuit over N clock cycles

equation.explanation: The minimum resolvable voltage step is equal to the shifted reference voltage divided by the number of clock cycles N during the conversion window.
equation.assumptions: N = 100 clock cycles over a 1 us sensing window (10 ns clock period).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by V_R_shift = 230 mV divided by 100 sample cycles.

modulator_feedback_ratio.description: Ratio of feedback active cycles (M) to total clock cycles (N) to achieve charge balance

equation.explanation: Equating the average charge pulled from the intensity branch and the reference branch over N clock cycles yields the balance condition.
equation.assumptions: Ideal charge conservation on the bucket capacitors over the measurement period.

sky130_expected.calculation: M / N = 80 mV / 230 mV = 0.348 (approx 35 out of 100 cycles Q is high; Qi output goes high 65 times).
sky130_expected.reasoning: Ratio reflects the proportion of V_I_shift relative to V_R_shift.

sensed_voltage.description: Digital reconstruction of the shifted intensity voltage from the modulator count

equation.explanation: The sensed analog voltage reconstructed digitally from the pulse count M out of N cycles.
equation.assumptions: Linear pulse-density conversion of the 1st-order DSM loop.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Reconstructed voltage closely tracks V_I_shift within the ±1 LSB quantization window.

average_power.description: Total average power dissipation during the active 1 us delta-sigma sensing window

equation.explanation: Average power drawn from the 1.8 V supply by the switched capacitors, current mirror, comparator, and SR latch during transient operation.
equation.assumptions: Clock frequency = 100 MHz (T = 10 ns), VDD = 1.8 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: At 100 MHz with switched caps ~100 fF and comparator dynamic switching, dynamic current is ~100 uA, giving P ≈ 1.8 V * 100 uA = 180 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dynamic power dominated by CV^2*f switching and comparator reset-evaluation cycles.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench simulating 1500 ns of DSM operation with non-overlapping clocks (phi1, phi2) at 100 MHz, measuring bucket capacitor voltages, output bitstream density, and power.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Delta-Sigma Modulator Sensing Circuit Testbench (Baker Fig. 17.36)
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Transistor size parameters (scaled for SKY130 0.15u min length)
.param W_xm1=1.5u  L_xm1=0.15u
.param W_xm2=1.5u  L_xm2=0.15u
.param W_xm3=7.5u  L_xm3=1.5u
.param W_xm4=1.5u  L_xm4=0.15u
.param W_xm5=1.5u  L_xm5=0.15u
.param W_xm6=1.5u  L_xm6=0.15u
.param W_xm7=1.5u  L_xm7=1.5u
.param W_xm8=1.5u  L_xm8=0.15u
.param W_xm9=1.5u  L_xm9=0.15u
.param W_xm10=1.5u L_xm10=0.15u
.param W_xm11=7.5u L_xm11=1.5u
.param W_xm12=1.5u L_xm12=1.5u
.param W_xm13=75u  L_xm13=1.5u
.param W_xm14=75u  L_xm14=1.5u
.param W_xm15=3.0u L_xm15=0.15u
.param W_xm16=3.0u L_xm16=0.15u
.param W_xm17=3.0u L_xm17=0.15u
.param W_xm18=3.0u L_xm18=0.15u
.param W_xm19=3.0u L_xm19=0.15u
.param W_xm20=3.0u L_xm20=0.15u
.param W_xm21=1.5u L_xm21=0.15u
.param W_xm22=1.5u L_xm22=0.15u
.param W_xm23=1.5u L_xm23=0.15u
.param W_xm24=1.5u L_xm24=0.15u

* Supply and Input DC Voltages
VDD VDD 0 1.8
Vr Vr 0 650m
Vi Vi 0 500m

* Two-phase non-overlapping clock (100 MHz, T=10ns)
* phi1: high from 0.5ns to 4.5ns
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 0.1n 0.1n 4.0n 10n)
* phi2: high from 5.5ns to 9.5ns
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 5.5n 0.1n 0.1n 4.0n 10n)

* Circuit under test (from prompt)
xm3 VDD N005 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm5 N006 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm7 vbuck vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm1 N005 phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N004 phi1 N006 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm4 N003 phi1 N005 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm6 N002 VDD N004 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm8 N001 Q N003 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}
xm9 vbuck Vi N002 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm9} l={L_xm9}
xm10 vbucki Vr N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm10} l={L_xm10}
xm11 VDD N006 VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm11} l={L_xm11}
xm12 vbucki vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm12} l={L_xm12}
xm13 0 vbuck 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm13} l={L_xm13}
xm14 0 vbucki 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm14} l={L_xm14}
xm15 n1 vbuck VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm15} l={L_xm15}
xm16 n2 vbucki VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm16} l={L_xm16}
xm17 n3 Out n1 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm17} l={L_xm17}
xm18 n4 Outi n2 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm18} l={L_xm18}
xm19 Outi phi2 n3 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm19} l={L_xm19}
xm20 Out phi2 n4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w={W_xm20} l={L_xm20}
xm21 Out Outi 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm21} l={L_xm21}
xm22 Outi Out 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm22} l={L_xm22}
xm23 Outi phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm23} l={L_xm23}
xm24 Out phi2 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm24} l={L_xm24}
X_U1 Out Qi Q VDD 0 NOR_2
X_U2 Q Outi Qi VDD 0 NOR_2

.subckt NOR_2 A B Out VDD GND
  xm3 out B N001 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3.0u l=0.15u
  xm8 N001 A VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=3.0u l=0.15u
  xm11 out B GND 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5u l=0.15u
  xm12 out A 0 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=1.5u l=0.15u
.ends NOR_2

* Initial condition to avoid metastability at t=0
.ic v(vbuck)=1.2 v(vbucki)=1.2 v(Q)=0 v(Qi)=1.8

.control
tran 0.1n 1500n uic

* Average bucket capacitor voltages during measurement window (500ns to 1500ns)
meas tran vbuck_avg avg v(vbuck) from=500n to=1500n
meas tran vbucki_avg avg v(vbucki) from=500n to=1500n

* Average duty cycle of Q (feedback active ratio M/N)
meas tran q_avg avg v(Q) from=500n to=1500n
let feedback_ratio = q_avg / 1.8
print feedback_ratio

* Average power during measurement window
meas tran i_vdd_avg avg i(VDD) from=500n to=1500n
let p_avg = -i_vdd_avg * 1.8
print p_avg

* Modulator reconstruction
let v_thn = 0.42
let vr_shift = 0.65 - v_thn
let vi_shift_sensed = vr_shift * feedback_ratio
let resolution = vr_shift / 100
print vr_shift vi_shift_sensed resolution

quit
.endc
.end
